title: US-short machine-layer record contract (design §10 + §11.1) — the per-run machine record the §10 no-dangling / evidence-traceback / field-registry validator focuses and the renderer renders from
description: Batch-3 shared STRUCTURAL contract for the machine layer (design §11.1: operation_impact + 全字段 + 原始分数 + decision_trace + registry → state/us_short/runs_private/). It freezes the SHAPE of a per-run machine record: run-level (schema_name/version/as_of + optional run_origin = the batch4 offline honesty-provenance fact) + rows[] (per-ticker decision) + each row's field_records[] (the §10 完整字段 registry record, 10 keys). This schema pins STRUCTURE ONLY (keys present + types + the validator-native disposition enum + the evidence_ref sub-shape). It deliberately does NOT re-enumerate the big frozen vocabularies (operation_impact levels / core_field_classes / impact_targets / evidence claim types / evidence_ref kinds / final_action / action_table columns) — those are owned by us_short_field_registry_governance + us_short_action_table_contract, and membership is enforced at runtime by engine/us_short_no_dangling_validator.py reading those frozen presets (single source, no third copy to drift). draft-07 cannot express the §10 cross-field invariants (forward no-dangling, core-field-must-hit-an-impact-target-or-shadow/drop, reverse evidence traceback, hard_veto-covers-final_action, risk_downgrade-soft-only, selection-vs-action_rank-explained) — those live in the validator + tests. A field_record carries the static 10-key registry declaration PLUS the runtime resolution (field_class / disposition / impact_target / claim_type / evidence_ref) the validator checks.

run_origin.description: batch4 honesty provenance (R-USSHORT-BATCH4-OFFLINE-ARTIFACT-MODE-PROVENANCE-GAP): the immutable execution/data-origin fact for a batch4 weekend run. Pinned by oneOf to EXACTLY one of the two honesty facts batch4 can produce — offline_test/caller_supplied_fixture (injected fixture) OR research_live/real_provider_pre_authoritative (real provider data, pre-authoritative research) — BOTH operational_use=not_authorized (live/operational-authoritative is hard-gated upstream → batch5). The oneOf enforces the run_mode↔data_origin pairing so a mismatched combo is rejected. Optional at the schema level only to keep pre-existing hand-built test records valid; assemble_machine_record always populates and validates it.

row.description: Per-ticker machine-layer decision record. additionalProperties is true: the rich machine layer (raw scores, per-engine traces, the rest of the §11.3 action_table columns) rides along; the validator only gates the §10-relevant fields.

field_record.description: §10 完整字段 registry record (the 10 const-pinned keys from us_short_field_registry_governance) + the runtime resolution the validator checks. Tight: additionalProperties false. Semantic emptiness/membership of the string-typed fields (current_landing_surface non-empty, operation_impact ∈ the 4 levels, field_class ∈ core classes, terminal ∈ a column/advisory landing, etc.) is enforced by the validator, NOT here — so the validator can be exercised with structurally-valid-but-semantically-bad records.
